A Random Lorem Ipsum

Source: R/Text.R
random_text.Rd

A Random Lorem Ipsum

Usage

random_text(nchars = NULL, nwords = NULL, offset = 0, var = 1)

Arguments

nchars

number of characters. One of the two params should be left NULL.

nwords

number of words to return. One of the two params should be left NULL.

offset

number of characters or words to offset the result by. Defaults to 0.

var

integer >= 1 selecting a "variant" of the text: each value returns a distinct slice of the lorem-ipsum corpus, so repeated calls (e.g. in a bulleted list) don't all look alike. Defaults to 1. The corpus wraps around when var is large.

Value

a text
